author: t. j. gough
title: Baylor women's tennis to face Colorado and Texas Tech in final regular season matches
text:
No. 34 Baylor women’s tennis will close out its regular season with two away matches, first traveling to Boulder, Colorado, to play the No. 66 Colorado Buffaloes on Thursday at 3 p.m., then returning to Texas for a match against No. 33 Texas Tech in Lubbock on Saturday at noon.
These matches mark the end of the regular season for Baylor, which currently holds a 12-7 overall record and is 7-4 in Big 12 conference play. The team has found success on the road this year with four wins out of six away games, including conference victories over Cincinnati, West Virginia and Kansas State.
Last weekend, Baylor split its matches—losing narrowly to BYU before defeating Utah by a single point. Zuzanna Kubacha continued her strong performance with two more wins, bringing her record to 21-6 for the season and earning her a national ranking of No. 114. She is joined in the singles rankings by Na Dong at No. 61.
Colorado enters Thursday’s match with a record of 10-11 overall and just two wins in Big 12 play this year. The Buffaloes have lost their last seven matches and do not have any nationally ranked players on their roster.
Texas Tech will host TCU before facing Baylor on Saturday. The Lady Raiders are coming off back-to-back losses but maintain a solid overall record of 14-9 and are ranked just above Baylor nationally at No. 33. Their doubles team of Yekaterina Dmitrichenko and Hailey Murphy is ranked No. 77 nationally.
Fans can follow live scoring online for both matches or watch court cameras as well as ESPN+’s Cracked Racquet’s CrossCourt Cast during the Texas Tech match.
